0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home) host the Sacramento Kings (0-2) in the Spurs' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with San Antonio ninth in the West and third in the Southwest, two games back, while Sacramento is 14th in the West and fourth in the Pacific, 2.5 games back. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Spurs won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 132-104 road win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
